tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
printf '%s\n' 'A 1 10' 'B 1 10' 'C 2 10' 'D 2 8' > "$tmpdir/items"

awk 'BEGIN {total=0; expected="A,B,C,D"; order=""; n=0}
{
  if (NF != 3) exit 2
  total += $2 * $3
  n++
  order=order (n>1 ? "," : "") $1
}

  printf "items=%s\ntotal=%d\nstatus=pending\nshipping=standard\nactive_patches=P2,P5\ncount=%d\n", order,total,n
